title: Agent A: A puzzle in disguise

The log has D3DMetal's 'Unsupported: IDXGIResource::GetSharedHandle', then crash dumps and the Epic overlay's crash reporter starting, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Doesn't get past the title screen in one report on an M1 with D3DMetal, the Epic copy. A Unity game, Direct3D 11.
